implemented: Pure deterministic evaluator with injected input/policy and no global clock reads.
Computes arrival interval from distance and speed ranges using milliseconds.
Applies reason priority for inactive session, policy, stale/unverified signal, invalid location, ambiguous target, non-green signal, slow/stopped and interval overlap.
Uses strict less-than for possible so equality/overlap is not optimistic.

scenarios: unverified timing, unapproved policy, non-green states, zero speed, NaN distance, negative remaining and stale signal never return possible

notClosedReasons: SA-10 explicitly asks for apps/mobile/lib/prediction pure Dart evaluatePrediction; Flutter/Dart SDK is unavailable locally, so the verified executable implementation is TypeScript only.
